# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.5 Part A Module 1, Western European Anti-Roman League & Atlantic Order (1450-1750, oe_weu_, slot 61). Generated by gen_western_europe.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Valid Eastern Roman / restored Roman host (non-rebel).
oe_weu_is_roman_host = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        tag = ROM
        tag = BYZ
    }
}

# Country scope. Eligible to run the lightweight rebel-guarded fallback pulse.
oe_weu_pulse_candidate = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        tag = ROM
        AND = {
            tag = BYZ
            NOT = { country_exists = c:ROM }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. True when global_var:oe_weu_host points to a live, non-rebel country.
oe_weu_has_live_host = {
    has_global_variable = oe_weu_host
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_host }
        country_exists = global_var:oe_weu_host
        global_var:oe_weu_host = { is_rebel_country = no }
    }
}

# Country scope. Host touches Lyon or any territory inside france_region (breaks Lily Accord immediately).
oe_weu_touches_gaul = {
    OR = {
        owns = location:lyon
        owns = location:paris
        any_owned_location = { region = region:france_region }
    }
}

# Country scope. Host holds any territory in france_region or iberia_region.
oe_weu_holds_gaul_or_iberia = {
    OR = {
        oe_weu_touches_gaul = yes
        owns = location:toledo
        owns = location:madrid
        owns = location:lisbon
        any_owned_location = { region = region:iberia_region }
    }
}

# Country scope. Anti-Roman Holy League trigger threshold (Blueprint 2.2):
#   (1) holds rome OR >= 15 locations in italy_region;
#   (2) oe_rr_count >= 5;
#   (3) holds any land in france_region or iberia_region.
oe_weu_league_threshold_met = {
    OR = {
        owns = location:rome
        any_owned_location = {
            region = region:italy_region
            count >= 15
        }
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_rr_count
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_count }
                var:oe_rr_count >= 5
            }
        }
        oe_weu_holds_gaul_or_iberia = yes
    }
}

# Any scope. At least one major Western European power exists (formables strictly country_exists guarded with 1337 fallback).
oe_weu_western_powers_exist = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:FRA c:FRA = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:HAB c:HAB = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:SPA c:SPA = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:CAS c:CAS = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:GBR c:GBR = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:ENG c:ENG = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:POR c:POR = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:NED c:NED = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:HOL c:HOL = { is_rebel_country = no } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Habsburg / Iberian encirclement axis exists (HAB or SPA/CAS).
oe_weu_habsburg_axis_alive = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:HAB c:HAB = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:SPA c:SPA = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:CAS c:CAS = { is_rebel_country = no } }
    }
}

# Country scope. France exists, is encircled by Habsburg/Iberia, and host has not touched Gaul or broken the pact.
oe_weu_fra_pact_eligible = {
    country_exists = c:FRA
    c:FRA = { is_rebel_country = no }
    oe_weu_habsburg_axis_alive = yes
    NOT = { oe_weu_touches_gaul = yes }
    trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fra_pact } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fra_pact = 1 } }
    trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fra_ruptured } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fra_ruptured = 1 } }
}

# Any scope. Twin-Eagle & Lily Accord is currently active.
oe_weu_fra_pact_active = {
    has_global_variable = oe_weu_fra_pact
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fra_pact }
        global_var:oe_weu_fra_pact = 1
    }
}

# Any scope. Live England / Great Britain (GBR with 1337 ENG fallback).
oe_weu_eng_alive = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:GBR c:GBR = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:ENG c:ENG = { is_rebel_country = no } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Live Lowlands commercial power (NED with 1337 HOL/BRB/BUR fallback).
oe_weu_lowlands_alive = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:NED c:NED = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:HOL c:HOL = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:BRB c:BRB = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:BUR c:BUR = { is_rebel_country = no } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Iberian Atlantic ports (lisbon, madrid, toledo) held by non-Roman Atlantic powers (has_owner guarded).
oe_weu_iberian_atlantic_alive = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:POR c:POR = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:SPA c:SPA = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:CAS c:CAS = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        location:lisbon = {
            has_owner = yes
            owner = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { tag = ROM } NOT = { tag = BYZ } }
        }
        location:madrid = {
            has_owner = yes
            owner = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { tag = ROM } NOT = { tag = BYZ } }
        }
        location:toledo = {
            has_owner = yes
            owner = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { tag = ROM } NOT = { tag = BYZ } }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Zero-override bridge to vanilla situation:treaty_of_tordesillas or post-1498 Atlantic maritime dominance.
oe_weu_atlantic_shift_active = {
    OR = {
        is_situation_active = situation:treaty_of_tordesillas
        AND = {
            current_year >= 1498
            OR = {
                oe_weu_iberian_atlantic_alive = yes
                oe_weu_eng_alive = yes
                oe_weu_lowlands_alive = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Read-only bridge to oe_ecc_ (church line) & oe_ar_ ecumenical council options.
oe_weu_ecc_bridge_ready = {
    OR = {
        has_variable = oe_ecc_concordat
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_ecc_uni
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_uni }
                var:oe_ecc_uni >= 35
            }
        }
        has_country_modifier = oe_ar_council_union
        has_country_modifier = oe_ar_council_roman
    }
}

# Country scope. Cross-line readiness for Mediterranean Trade Counter-Offensive:
#   (Trajan's Canal stage >= 3 OR Silk Road Twin Phoenix done) AND Roman Company held (oe_cmp_holder).
oe_weu_counter_trade_ready = {
    has_variable = oe_cmp_holder
    OR = {
        AND = {
            has_global_variable = oe_red_canal_stage
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_red_canal_stage }
                global_var:oe_red_canal_stage >= 3
            }
        }
        has_global_variable = oe_srk_done
    }
}
